experiment.falsification_test: For at least 100 hourly gap-down events in BTC-USD exceeding 2% with a 30-hour reversion probability below 5% (i.e., 5% return in 30 hours), the observed 30-hour return distribution must show a mean return greater than 0.05 (5%) or a median return above 0.05 to falsify the hypothesis.
